headline: Names a Providence, Rhode Island post office building the "Sister Ann Keefe Post Office."
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 820 Elmwood Avenue in Providence, Rhode Island. The building is now officially called the "Sister Ann Keefe Post Office." It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 22, 2015.
